_note: Test data, read only by tools/test-platform.mjs: tools/build-derived.mjs no longer reads it, since the platform ships from NSS itself (tools/nss-platform.json). Which tier of the online Survival Golf tee platform the player stood on in each online round, read from the captures by eye (two independent judges agreed on all 13; five were re-checked by hand). A round is a hole at one wind. test-platform checks each round against the decoded platform: the round's badges must fit a standing spot of its judged tier and none of the other's (a badge is the floor of the flat yards from the ball to the cup). tierOffsetYd is the capture measurement, kept as the confirmation of the decoded offset, 3.5 m = 3.83 yd back and 1.568 m = 1.72 yd up (tools/nss-platform.json tierOffset). Player-confirmed game facts: every hole has the same two-tiered platform, four slots on the lower tier and four on the upper, the upper directly behind the lower and raised a few feet, so a slot's upper and lower positions differ by one constant offset on every hole. Upper-tier frames show other players' heads cut off by the deck edge in front; lower-tier frames show the glass-faced upper deck with its stairs rising behind or beside the player.
tierOffsetFrom: H11, the one hole captured from both tiers: the W6 round's median avatar stands 4.02 yd further from the green than the W0 round's, measured along the tee -> green-centre axis (from the WSR tee-pad centre, which is within 0.2 deg of the start -> green direction on H11; the avatar marker wanders ~1.5 px = 1.3 yd on H11 with the aim, so take it as 4 +- 1 yd)
